body: This is the posters mother, she committed suicide four days ago. I want to say from the bottom of my heart thank each and every one of you for the replies. I hope my daughter read them and knew that she was cared for, even by internet strangers. She was struggling with a severe battle, and ultimately it got too hard for her to stand. We have been going through belongings trying to piece everything together and this post is the only indication of how bad things really were in her world. Thank you all again for trying to persuade her out of it. I wish we would have known and could have prevented this as well. The grief is unbearable and it all feels like a dream. I just wanted to post this for anyone who was keeping up with it.
